prohibited_zone_types: residential zones outside Visitor Destination Areas
regulations.notes: Kauai defines Transient Vacation Rentals (TVRs) as any rental under 180 days. TVRs outside Visitor Destination Areas (VDAs) require a Non-Conforming Use Certificate (TVR-NCU) to operate legally. Only properties in VDAs or with legally established TVR status may operate STRs. Permits are limited and grandfathered; new approvals outside VDAs are very rare.
